_what: Golden expectations for the EVE provider (SPEC-005 part 2 of 4). For each fixture variant: the EVE lookup key and the call the provider must produce from REAL published EVE data.
_what_is_NOT_here: No EVE_scores_ASM values. evemodel.org states its data is MIT-licensed, but the LICENSE.txt it serves is copyrighted to the SITE's author rather than to the Marks Lab / OATML who produced the predictions, so whether it governs the DATA is unsettled (decision D3). This repo applies the same no-commit discipline it applies to AlphaMissense. What IS committed is our own assertion about what the tool reports for a named key; the test proves it against a locally fetched, gitignored cache and SKIPs with a populate instruction when that cache is absent.
_key: <uniprot_entry_name>/<protein_variant>, e.g. P53_HUMAN/R175H. NOTE this differs from AlphaMissense's key, which uses the UniProt ACCESSION (P04637/R175H). Both are resolved through the identifier seam (SPEC-027), which was extended additively with `uniprot_entry_name` for exactly this reason.
_expected_call_vocabulary: This repo's ToolCall vocabulary (contracts/variant_effect.py): pathogenic | benign | uncertain. EVE's own published labels are Benign / Uncertain / Pathogenic -- a THIRD vocabulary after AlphaMissense's two. The provider normalizes; nothing privileges any of them.
_three_no_coverage_states: Deliberately distinguished, because they mean different things and only one is a gap in our wiring: (1) EVE does not publish the protein at all -- FBXW7 and RNF43, see decision D-009; (2) EVE publishes the row but assigned no score; (3) the change is not a single-aa substitution. All three yield None. A key that SHOULD be present but is missing raises EveScoreNotFound instead.
_corroboration: `eve_shipped_clinvar` and `eve_shipped_gnomad_gv2` are the ClinVar_ClinicalSignificance and frequency_gv2 values EVE itself ships alongside each prediction. They are recorded as an INDEPENDENT axis and are never used to form a call. Where EVE's own class disagrees with the ClinVar significance it carries, that disagreement is RECORDED, not resolved -- see docs/probes/consensus-two-providers.md.
